content.json:
# SaaS Verified Usage and Flexera Export Workbook
Correlates Microsoft Defender Advanced Hunting signals to produce verified SaaS usage evidence with IdentityInfo-enriched user attributes and Flexera export readiness.

> **Evidence model (priority order):**  
> **1 – Verified Activity** – User performed an app action recorded in CloudAppEvents (ActionType present).  
> **2 – Verified Sign-In** – Successful authentication in EntraIdSignInEvents (ErrorCode = 0) or IdentityLogonEvents (ActionType = LogonSuccess).  
> **Unknown** – No matching evidence in the selected time range.

content.title: Executive KPI Tiles
Application-Level Summary
content.query:
let StartTime = todatetime('{TimeRange:start}');
let EndTime   = todatetime('{TimeRange:end}');
let AppActivity = union isfuzzy=true
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application)
     | extend EmailAddress = tolower(tostring(coalesce(
           column_ifexists('AccountUpn',''),
           iff(isnotempty(tostring(AccountName)) and isnotempty(tostring(AccountDomain)),
               strcat(tostring(AccountName),'@',tostring(AccountDomain)), ''))))
     | where isnotempty(EmailAddress) and EmailAddress != '@'
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress, Evidence='Verified Activity'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let EntraSignIn = union isfuzzy=true
    (EntraIdSignInEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn) and ErrorCode == 0
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let IdentityLogon = union isfuzzy=true
    (IdentityLogonEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where ActionType == 'LogonSuccess' and isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
union AppActivity, EntraSignIn, IdentityLogon
| summarize
    LastActive     = max(Timestamp),
    TotalDaysUsed  = dcount(startofday(Timestamp)),
    HasAppActivity = max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Activity',1,0)),
    HasSignIn      = max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Sign-In',1,0)),
    TotalUsers     = dcount(EmailAddress),
    ActivityUsers  = dcountif(EmailAddress, Evidence=='Verified Activity'),
    SignInUsers    = dcountif(EmailAddress, Evidence=='Verified Sign-In')
    by Application
| extend TopEvidence=case(HasAppActivity==1,'Verified Activity',HasSignIn==1,'Verified Sign-In','Unknown')
| project Application, ['Top evidence']=TopEvidence, ['Total users']=TotalUsers, ['Verified activity users']=ActivityUsers, ['Verified sign-in users']=SignInUsers, ['Last seen']=LastActive, ['Total distinct usage days']=TotalDaysUsed
| order by ['Total users'] desc

content.title: Verified Activity vs Verified Sign-In Users by App
content.query:
let StartTime = todatetime('{TimeRange:start}');
let EndTime   = todatetime('{TimeRange:end}');
let AppActivity = union isfuzzy=true
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application)
     | extend EmailAddress = tolower(tostring(coalesce(
           column_ifexists('AccountUpn',''),
           iff(isnotempty(tostring(AccountName)) and isnotempty(tostring(AccountDomain)),
               strcat(tostring(AccountName),'@',tostring(AccountDomain)), ''))))
     | where isnotempty(EmailAddress) and EmailAddress != '@'
     | project Application, EmailAddress, Evidence='Verified Activity'),
    (datatable(Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let EntraSignIn = union isfuzzy=true
    (EntraIdSignInEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn) and ErrorCode == 0
     | project Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let IdentityLogon = union isfuzzy=true
    (IdentityLogonEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where ActionType == 'LogonSuccess' and isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
     | project Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
union AppActivity, EntraSignIn, IdentityLogon
| summarize HasActivity=max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Activity',1,0)) by Application, EmailAddress
| extend Series=iff(HasActivity==1,'Verified Activity users','Sign-In only users')
| summarize Users=dcount(EmailAddress) by Application, Series
| order by Application asc

content.title: User-Level Inventory
content.query:
let StartTime = todatetime('{TimeRange:start}');
let EndTime   = todatetime('{TimeRange:end}');
let MinimumDaysUsed              = toint('{MinimumDaysUsed}');
let AppFilterParam               = trim(' ', tostring('{AppFilter}'));
let UserFilterParam              = trim(' ', tostring('{UserFilter}'));
let DepartmentFilterParam        = trim(' ', tostring('{DepartmentFilter}'));
let CountryFilterParam           = trim(' ', tostring('{CountryFilter}'));
let UsageClassificationFilterParam = trim(' ', tostring('{UsageClassificationFilter}'));
let UserInfo = IdentityInfo
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountUpn
    | project EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), DisplayName=tostring(coalesce(FullName, AccountDisplayName)), Department=tostring(Department), Country=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('Country',''), column_ifexists('CountryCode','')));
let AppActivity = union isfuzzy=true
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application)
     | extend EmailAddress = tolower(tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('AccountUpn',''), iff(isnotempty(tostring(AccountName)) and isnotempty(tostring(AccountDomain)), strcat(tostring(AccountName),'@',tostring(AccountDomain)), ''))))
     | where isnotempty(EmailAddress) and EmailAddress != '@'
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress, AnyDisplayName=tostring(AccountDisplayName), ActionType, Evidence='Verified Activity'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, AnyDisplayName:string, ActionType:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let EntraSignIn = union isfuzzy=true
    (EntraIdSignInEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn) and ErrorCode == 0
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), AnyDisplayName=tostring(AccountDisplayName), ActionType='SignInSuccess', Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, AnyDisplayName:string, ActionType:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let IdentityLogon = union isfuzzy=true
    (IdentityLogonEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where ActionType == 'LogonSuccess' and isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), AnyDisplayName=tostring(AccountDisplayName), ActionType, Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, AnyDisplayName:string, ActionType:string, Evidence:string)[]);
union AppActivity, EntraSignIn, IdentityLogon
| summarize LastActive=max(Timestamp), TotalDaysUsed=dcount(startofday(Timestamp)), HasAppActivity=max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Activity',1,0)), HasSignIn=max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Sign-In',1,0)), EvidenceSources=make_set(Evidence,5), SampleActions=make_set(ActionType,5), AnyDisplayName=take_any(AnyDisplayName) by Application, EmailAddress
| extend UsageClassification=case(HasAppActivity==1,'Verified Activity',HasSignIn==1,'Verified Sign-In','Unknown'), ActivityStatus=case(isnull(LastActive),'Unknown',LastActive>=ago(30d),'Active 30d',LastActive>=ago(90d),'Active 90d',LastActive<ago(90d),'Inactive >90d','Unknown')
| join kind=leftouter UserInfo on EmailAddress
| extend DisplayName=coalesce(DisplayName1,AnyDisplayName), Department=coalesce(Department1,''), Country=coalesce(Country1,'')
| where isempty(AppFilterParam) or Application in~ (split(AppFilterParam,','))
| where isempty(UserFilterParam) or EmailAddress in~ (split(UserFilterParam,','))
| where isempty(DepartmentFilterParam) or Department in~ (split(DepartmentFilterParam,','))
| where isempty(CountryFilterParam) or Country in~ (split(CountryFilterParam,','))
| where isempty(UsageClassificationFilterParam) or UsageClassification in~ (split(UsageClassificationFilterParam,','))
| where TotalDaysUsed >= iif(isnull(MinimumDaysUsed),1,MinimumDaysUsed)
| project ['Display name']=DisplayName, ['Email address']=EmailAddress, Country, Department, Application, ['Activity status']=ActivityStatus, Classification=UsageClassification, ['Last active']=LastActive, ['Total days used']=TotalDaysUsed, ['Evidence sources']=tostring(EvidenceSources), ['Sample actions']=tostring(SampleActions)
| order by ['Last active'] desc

content.title: Evidence and Classification Reason
content.query:
let StartTime = todatetime('{TimeRange:start}');
let EndTime   = todatetime('{TimeRange:end}');
let AppActivity = union isfuzzy=true
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application)
     | extend EmailAddress = tolower(tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('AccountUpn',''), iff(isnotempty(tostring(AccountName)) and isnotempty(tostring(AccountDomain)), strcat(tostring(AccountName),'@',tostring(AccountDomain)), ''))))
     | where isnotempty(EmailAddress) and EmailAddress != '@'
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress, Evidence='Verified Activity'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let EntraSignIn = union isfuzzy=true
    (EntraIdSignInEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn) and ErrorCode == 0
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In (Entra)'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let IdentityLogon = union isfuzzy=true
    (IdentityLogonEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where ActionType == 'LogonSuccess' and isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In (Logon)'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
union AppActivity, EntraSignIn, IdentityLogon
| summarize LastActive=max(Timestamp), TotalDaysUsed=dcount(startofday(Timestamp)), HasAppActivity=max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Activity',1,0)), HasEntraSignIn=max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Sign-In (Entra)',1,0)), HasIdentityLogon=max(iff(Evidence=='Verified Sign-In (Logon)',1,0)) by Application, EmailAddress
| extend ['Usage classification']=case(HasAppActivity==1,'Verified Activity',HasEntraSignIn==1 or HasIdentityLogon==1,'Verified Sign-In','Unknown'), ['Classification reason']=case(HasAppActivity==1,'CloudAppEvents activity exists for this user and app.',HasEntraSignIn==1,'Successful Entra ID sign-in exists (ErrorCode=0).',HasIdentityLogon==1,'Successful identity logon event exists (LogonSuccess).','No matching evidence found in the selected time range.')
| project ['Email address']=EmailAddress, Application, ['App activity (CloudAppEvents)']=iff(HasAppActivity==1,'Yes','No'), ['Sign-in (Entra)']=iff(HasEntraSignIn==1,'Yes','No'), ['Sign-in (Identity Logon)']=iff(HasIdentityLogon==1,'Yes','No'), ['Usage classification'], ['Classification reason'], ['Last active']=LastActive, ['Total days used']=TotalDaysUsed
| order by ['Last active'] desc

     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
let IdentityLogon = union isfuzzy=true
    (IdentityLogonEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where ActionType == 'LogonSuccess' and isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
     | project Timestamp, Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Evidence='Verified Sign-In'),
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Application:string, EmailAddress:string, Evidence:string)[]);
union AppActivity, EntraSignIn, IdentityLogon

| extend UsageClassification=case(HasAppActivity==1,'Verified Activity',HasSignIn==1,'Verified Sign-In','Unknown'), ActivityStatus=case(isnull(LastActive),'Unknown',LastActive>=ago(30d),'Active 30d',LastActive>=ago(90d),'Active 90d',LastActive<ago(90d),'Inactive >90d','Unknown'), DiscoveryType=case(HasAppActivity==1,'Connected App Activity',HasSignIn==1,'Identity Verified','Unknown')

| join kind=leftouter UserInfo on EmailAddress
| extend DisplayName=coalesce(DisplayName1,tostring(split(EmailAddress,'@')[0])), Department=coalesce(Department1,''), Country=coalesce(Country1,'')
| project ['Display name']=DisplayName, ['Email address']=EmailAddress, Country, Department, Subscriptions=Application, Classification=UsageClassification, ['Activity status']=ActivityStatus, ['Discovery type']=DiscoveryType, ['Last active']=LastActive, ['Total days used']=TotalDaysUsed

content.title: Apps With Sign-In Evidence But No CloudAppEvents Activity
content.query:
let StartTime = todatetime('{TimeRange:start}');
let EndTime   = todatetime('{TimeRange:end}');
let ActivityApps = union isfuzzy=true
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application)
     | extend EmailAddress = tolower(tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('AccountUpn',''), iff(isnotempty(tostring(AccountName)) and isnotempty(tostring(AccountDomain)), strcat(tostring(AccountName),'@',tostring(AccountDomain)), ''))))
     | where isnotempty(EmailAddress) and EmailAddress != '@'
     | project Application, EmailAddress),
    (datatable(Application:string, EmailAddress:string)[]);
let SignInApps = union isfuzzy=true
    (EntraIdSignInEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime) | where isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn) and ErrorCode==0 | project Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn))),
    (IdentityLogonEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime) | where ActionType=='LogonSuccess' and isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(AccountUpn) | project Application, EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn))),
    (datatable(Application:string, EmailAddress:string)[]);
SignInApps
| summarize SignInUsers=dcount(EmailAddress) by Application
| join kind=leftouter (ActivityApps | summarize ActivityUsers=dcount(EmailAddress) by Application) on Application
| extend ActivityUsers=coalesce(ActivityUsers,0)
| where ActivityUsers == 0
| project Application, ['Sign-in users']=SignInUsers, ['Activity users']=ActivityUsers, Gap='Sign-in evidence only – no CloudAppEvents activity recorded'
| order by ['Sign-in users'] desc

content.title: Active Users Missing IdentityInfo Enrichment (Department or Country)
content.query:
let StartTime = todatetime('{TimeRange:start}');
let EndTime   = todatetime('{TimeRange:end}');
let ActiveUsers = union isfuzzy=true
    (CloudAppEvents
     | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime)
     | where isnotempty(Application)
     | extend EmailAddress = tolower(tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('AccountUpn',''), iff(isnotempty(tostring(AccountName)) and isnotempty(tostring(AccountDomain)), strcat(tostring(AccountName),'@',tostring(AccountDomain)), ''))))
     | where isnotempty(EmailAddress) and EmailAddress != '@'
     | project EmailAddress),
    (EntraIdSignInEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTime..EndTime) | where isnotempty(AccountUpn) and ErrorCode==0 | project EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn))),
    (datatable(EmailAddress:string)[]);
let UserInfo = IdentityInfo
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountUpn
    | project EmailAddress=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)), Department=tostring(Department), Country=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('Country',''), column_ifexists('CountryCode','')));
ActiveUsers
| summarize by EmailAddress
| join kind=leftouter UserInfo on EmailAddress
| extend MissingDepartment=iff(isempty(Department),'Yes','No'), MissingCountry=iff(isempty(Country),'Yes','No'), InIdentityInfo=iff(isnotempty(EmailAddress1),'Yes','No')
| where MissingDepartment=='Yes' or MissingCountry=='Yes' or InIdentityInfo=='No'
| project ['Email address']=EmailAddress, ['In IdentityInfo']=InIdentityInfo, ['Missing department']=MissingDepartment, ['Missing country']=MissingCountry
| order by ['Email address'] asc

content.title: Defender Table Health – Row Counts in Selected Range
content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (CloudAppEvents      | where Timestamp between (todatetime('{TimeRange:start}') .. todatetime('{TimeRange:end}')) | summarize Rows=count() | extend TableName='CloudAppEvents'),
    (EntraIdSignInEvents | where Timestamp between (todatetime('{TimeRange:start}') .. todatetime('{TimeRange:end}')) | summarize Rows=count() | extend TableName='EntraIdSignInEvents'),
    (IdentityLogonEvents | where Timestamp between (todatetime('{TimeRange:start}') .. todatetime('{TimeRange:end}')) | summarize Rows=count() | extend TableName='IdentityLogonEvents'),
    (IdentityInfo        | summarize Rows=count() | extend TableName='IdentityInfo (snapshot)'),
    (CloudAuditEvents    | where Timestamp between (todatetime('{TimeRange:start}') .. todatetime('{TimeRange:end}')) | summarize Rows=count() | extend TableName='CloudAuditEvents')
| extend Status=iff(Rows>0,'Data present','No data in selected range or table unavailable')
| project TableName, Rows, Status
| order by TableName asc

content.json:
### Additional guidance
- **CloudAppEvents** is the primary evidence source. If absent, only sign-in classification (Priority 2) is possible.
- **EntraIdSignInEvents** covers Entra ID SaaS app sign-ins. ErrorCode = 0 = success.
- **IdentityLogonEvents** covers on-prem and device logons; Application may be sparse for pure cloud SaaS.
- **IdentityInfo** is a snapshot table. Users missing Department or Country require enrichment from HR/Entra.
- To improve email resolution from CloudAppEvents ensure AccountUpn is populated, or AccountName@AccountDomain resolves correctly in your tenant.
- Sample apps to validate: Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, Salesforce, Workday.
